zoe: Heads-up: rolling v3.2.1 canary (5%) in eu-west-1 in ~2m. Change window 23:00-00:00 UTC. Preflight green.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary allocation created (5%).

kev: metrics link https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/1735 p95 +20% on canary vs baseline, taily.

mohit: Any increase in 5xx?

sre-oncall: 5xx flat. Seeing kvcache eviction bursts on canary pods at 23:02. Evict rate ~3x baseline.

zoe: Ok let's not widen traffic. Propose pinning canary to v3.2.0-quant while infra/ML triage. Vote?

kev: hold + pin.

mohit: hold. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: hold. Will collect logs.

kev: @deploy-bot pause further percent increases.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: traffic increase suspended per request.

mohit: I'll pin canary to v3.2.0-quant now.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.2.0-quant (canary-eu-west-1-4).

zoe: Thanks. Monitor p95 + evictions for 10m. If stable reconvene and consider cautious bump.

sre-oncall: Quick log snippet at spike:
```
[23:02:01] kvcache: evict key=ctx-2048 shard=1 reason=mem_pressure
[23:02:01] model: req=id=x7ab seq_len=4096 latency=498ms
[23:02:02] kvcache: miss key=ctx-2048
```

kev: I'll add a release note blurb: "Canary in eu-west-1 temporarily pinned to v3.2.0-quant due to KV cache eviction-induced latency on v3.2.1." Any objections?

zoe: None. I'll file INV-2027 for deeper investigation and update the release notes."
